purpose: Teach: 長期間/しまわ/すんなり/売り切れ/兆し/区切り/近日/工具

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 会社、長期間、続けることが、何より大切だ。
lines.en: Staying with a company for the long term — that's what matters most.
lines.style: Measured and grounded. Long breath before speaking. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. The voice of someone who has watched decades of business unfold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社内の重要書類、しまわないと、信用に関わります。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We have to keep our internal documents properly organized. It's critical for maintaining trust.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. No hesitation, no rushing. Clear acknowledgment of the principle. Sits slightly forward, engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 交渉、すんなり進む時こそ、油断するな。
lines.en: When negotiations are going smoothly — that's when you can't let your guard down.
lines.style: Sharper edge now. A quiet caution underneath. Leans forward slightly, eyes direct. The tone of someone passing on hard-won knowledge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。新商品、初日で売り切れ、嬉しい悲鳴です。
lines.en: Understood. Our first day sales completely sold out — it's wonderful to have that kind of response.
lines.style: Warm brightness breaking through. A small lift in the voice, genuine pleasure. But grounded, not overexcited. The pride of someone who worked for this moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業績、回復の兆しが見える時、慎重さを忘れるな。
lines.en: When you start seeing signs of recovery in your numbers, don't lose your caution. That's when mistakes happen.
lines.style: Deliberate and firm. A slight pause before 'caution.' The voice of experience. Not lecturing — sharing a truth he's seen cost others.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業からの区切り、しっかり振り返ります。
lines.en: Yes. We're going to take time to reflect carefully on everything since the company's founding.
lines.style: Quiet determination. The word 'carefully' carries weight. Shoulders settle. This is commitment made real through deliberate speech.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近日、社内記念行事に、私も参加するよ。
lines.en: I'll be there for the company anniversary celebration coming up soon.
lines.style: Warmth underneath the simplicity. A promise kept. The voice of someone who has stayed, who will show up. Slight smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業当時の工具、社史館に展示予定です。
lines.en: Thank you, sir. We're planning to display some of the original tools from when the company started in our corporate museum.
lines.style: Pride and respect woven together. Clear, careful — this matters. A sense of honoring the past while standing in the present. Grounded but glowing.
